invariants.name: A merge needs a grant of the base branch profile or a covering prompt of a person
Only a person's prompt sets a grant, and a framed prompt is not one
No merge goes through an MCP tool
No merge goes ahead after a guard error

carrier.contract: Each guard maps one decoded hook call to one Verdict. The PR read gives the base branch authority with the threads and the checks. combineAll keeps the verdict of the highest rank, so a deny of one guard stays a deny.

category.equality: Two verdicts are equal when their kind and their text are equal. Two base authorities are equal when their kind, their commit and their merge profile are equal.

laws.reason: The guards run side by side on one hook call, and the record declares no composite arrow. This change adds no composition operator, map, functor or monad.

abstraction.hides: The GraphQL read of the profile at the base tip and its parse, the frame test of a prompt, the token grammar of an MCP tool name and the failure verdict of the merge guard.
callersKnow: A merge needs a grant of the profile on the PR base branch, or a covering prompt of a person in this turn.
A working-tree edit of the profile changes no merge verdict.
A workflow brief, a relay message and a Cursor background prompt never give a grant.
Each MCP tool with a merge word gets a deny, and an error of the merge guard on a merge gives a deny.
abstraction.deletionTest: Deleting baseAuthorityFrom puts the profile read back in the guard, and each caller must again choose a working tree, a cwd and an origin repo. Deleting isMcpMergeTool brings back a list of known tools for each host.

alternatives.name: Read origin/<base> from local git
alternatives.rejectedBecause: A session can move a remote-tracking ref with git update-ref or a fetch.

alternatives.name: Deny each write of the profile
alternatives.rejectedBecause: Shell writes, branch switches and old worktrees are open sets, so the guard cannot cover them.

alternatives.name: Add only the literal prefix of the workflow frame
alternatives.rejectedBecause: The next frame label passes again.

alternatives.name: Keep an exact deny list of MCP merge tools
alternatives.rejectedBecause: The list missed CoCode and Linear, and it drifts with each host.

omitted: The GraphQL reply is abstracted to one base observation of turn, standing, base or unread.
The frame test is abstracted to the source class frame.
The MCP token grammar is abstracted to two channels, gh and mcp.
A guard error is abstracted to one fault flag for each merge.
One repo is modeled, so the same-repo rule holds by the shape of the base read.
The host decides the prompt source and the attended variables, and the model takes them as true.

bounds: Attended and unattended sessions, four base authorities, three working-tree authorities, two PRs, two channels, a guard error or none, and prompts of one or two of seven clause classes from four sources.
Each combination of four path facts for one write and an optional commit.
Each set of changes from four change kinds in three places, and 16 git commands with their documented effects.

negative.defect: The merge guard reads the working-tree profile, so an uncommitted edit of merge.authority gives standing merge authority with no owner word.

limits: The finite model takes the base read, the prompt source class, the attended state and the tool channel as true observations.
The model does not show that the TypeScript code refines it. The linked controls and review examine that relation.
A session that can push to an unprotected base branch can change the base profile. Branch protection is the control for that case.
Exact-head CI, review, Shipping and every ordinary gate stay required.
